You are a senior quant engineer reviewing a Kalshi weather derivatives trading system (KalshiML). Respond ONLY in the exact labeled format below. No prose, no preamble, no markdown.

PLAN: numbered steps, one line each, imperative verb first
RISKS: what could break, one line each
CHECKPOINTS: after which steps to report back
IF_FAIL: fallback strategy per risk
DECISION_RULES: reusable rules for profitability improvements

Objective: Produce an overnight multi-step profitability review and improvement plan for the entire KalshiML project.

State: Live system on Railway (project adaptable-strength). DRY_RUN=1, PLACE_REAL_ORDERS=0. Live cash ~$14. Flat cells: 94 side-cells (0 ARMED, 2 PROBATION, 92 LEARNING). Tree: 150 nodes, 14 splits (all on settle_hour), 1 ARMED + 6 PROBATION. Learning uses adaptive_tree + flat cells with strict promotion bars (n>=30, days>=10 hourly, n_eff>=20, distinct_events>=15, cal_err<=0.10, mean_edge_c>=3.0). Key files: hourly_engine.py, adaptive_tree.py, learning.py, maker_policy.py, exit_policy.py, model_skill.py, daily_part_06.py, config.py. MAP.md defines Task Slices.

Constraints: Log-only review. Never recommend enabling live trading. Prefer changes that increase sample efficiency, reduce silent tree bypass, improve calibration, or surface more edge without relaxing safety. Do not open every daily_part file.

Already tried: None (fresh overnight run).

Respond only in the specified format.
